mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'ATTENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS attended_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absent_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'EXCUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS excused_count FROM meetup_fulfillment mf JOIN meetup m ON m.id = mf.meetup_id WHERE mf.account_id = #{accountId} AND m.meetup_mode = 'OFFLINE'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM meetup_review WHERE reviewee_account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'VISIBLE'
